results.title: Asia's Biggest Sporting Showdown Begins! A Limited-Time, 360-Degree Open-Top Bus Takes to the Streets of Host City Nagoya
results.description: NAGOYA, Japan , Aug. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- From September to October, top athletes from 45 countries will compete at the Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 and Asian Para Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 , held mainly around Nagoya , Aichi Prefecture. Nagoya is a major city ranking just behind Tokyo and Osaka, offering visitors everything from history and anime pilgrimage sites to incredible food and cutting-edge shopping — making it hugely popular with travelers visiting Japan. And there's one especially efficient way to make the most of everything Nagoya has to offer — the " Aichi-Nagoya OPEN TOP BUS ", running for a limited time only from Friday, September 18 through Saturday, October 24, during the Games. Ride in the open air on a roofless double-decker bus and take in Nagoya's major sightseeing spots in just about an hour. Here are the two unmissable routes you can only experience right now! The open-top bus running through Nagoya by night. Available for a limited time only — with distinctive routes for both day and night. Two Handpicked Routes — Day and Night — to Match Your Travel Plans The biggest draw is the sweeping 360-degree panorama from your special seat about 3 meters above the ground. It lets you capture plenty of dramatic photos and videos only possible during the operating period — to cherish wonderful memories of your trip. Both routes depart from and return to the easily accessible area in front of Nagoya Station (Meieki Parklet). [Day Course] Take In Nagoya 's Classic Panoramic Views! This popular, classic route takes you around must-see landmarks in the city center. Two departures run each day, with a total ride time of about 60 minutes. During the bus tour, you will also be able to get off at the final landmark " Nagoya Castle " and explore at your own pace. Route: FUJI NAGOYA SCIENCE MUSEUM → Osu, Nagoya's largest downtown district → Oasis 21 Park → Chubu Electric Power MIRAI TOWER (TV Tower) → IG Arena → Nagoya Castle [Night Course] A Thrilling Expressway Drive & Spectacular Night Views Enjoy an exhilarating ride along the city expressway, plus close-up views of Nagoya's dazzling illuminated skyline. Two departures run each day, with a total ride time of about 85 minutes. Route: Nagoya Expressway → Oasis 21 Park → Chubu Electric Power MIRAI TOWER (TV Tower) → Nagoya Castle , the Aichi Prefectural Government Office, and Nagoya City Hall → the high-rise buildings around Nagoya Station, and more The view from aboard the open-top bus. Enjoy Nagoya, one of Japan’s leading cities, from a whole new vantage point high above the streets. Left: Nagoya, the stage for the Asian Games and Asian Para Games, is also packed with sightseeing spots of its own. Top right: Tour around Nagoya without ever leaving your seat — an efficient way to take in all the highlights. Bottom right: The night tour, with its atmosphere so different from daytime, is highly recommended too. The bus runs daily from Friday, September 18 through Saturday, October 24, 2026. Tickets can be purchased on the official " Aichi-Nagoya OPEN TOP BUS " website. Don't miss your chance for a photo opportunity from the very special seats available only this fall! Combo Ticket Sets from Nagoya Station: Smooth, Seamless Access to Nearby Sightseeing Spots! If you'd like to use Nagoya as your base and explore the surrounding area, we recommend the Inuyama and Gifu areas, both especially popular among visitors from across Asia. [ Inuyama Castle Town ] Inuyama Castle , a National Treasure, boasts Japan's oldest wooden castle keep. In the surrounding castle town, which still retains its Edo-period charm, you can visit Sanko Inari Shrine — known for its blessings of matchmaking and money luck — and enjoy some food-stall hopping along the way. [ KINKAZAN ROPEWAY ] This ropeway climbs to the summit of Mount Kinka , the symbol of Gifu City. It's popular for views that combine the natural beauty of the majestic Nagara River with the cityscape of Gifu spread out below. [ Takayama ] Home to Hida Takayama's historic townscape and well-known hot spring resorts, this area is also a gateway to the World Heritage site of Shirakawa-go , making it explosively popular with international visitors. Left: Inuyama Castle — a National Treasure and one of Japan’s foremost castles — is within easy day-trip distance from Nagoya. Top right: The KINKAZAN ROPEWAY offers a convenient way up to Mount Kinka, with sweeping views over Gifu City. At the foot of the mountain, you can also enjoy food-stall hopping. Bottom right: Takayama, one of Japan’s most popular tourist destinations, is also conveniently accessible from Nagoya. Meitetsu (Nagoya Railroad) sells combo ticket sets that make access to these nearby sightseeing areas much more convenient. Through Meitetsu , you can purchase, all at once, the different transportation tickets (train and bus) you'll need to travel from Nagoya to each sightseeing area — saving you the time and hassle of lining up at separate ticket counters. Trains also accept QR-code tickets, so you can ride seamlessly with just your smartphone. There are also plans that bundle in admission fees for facilities like Inuyama Castle , perfect for anyone hoping to enjoy sightseeing across multiple areas. This year, why not make Nagoya the heart of your journey through Japan?

results.title: AIMX Singapore 2026 Accelerates AI Deployment Through Catalysing Industry Innovation and Advancing Global Collaborations
results.description: More than 60 countries to convene in Singapore as business leaders, policymakers and technology innovators explore practical AI adoption and cross-border partnership s. SINGAPORE , Aug. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As organisations accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) beyond pilot projects and into enterprise-wide deployment, AIMX Singapore 2026 will convene business leaders, policymakers, technology innovators and researchers from more than 60 countries to showcase how AI is delivering measurable impact across industries. The event will open with an Opening Address by Guest-of-Honour Mr Tan Kiat How, Senior Minister of State, Ministry of Digital Development and Information, Republic of Singapore, before bringing together global AI ecosystems to drive business collaboration, technology adoption and international partnerships across healthcare, robotics, logistics, transportation, retail and other key sectors. Catalysing Conversations around Industry Innovation Building on Singapore's ambitions to become a global hub for responsible AI innovation and deployment across industries, AIMX Singapore 2026 will present a conference programme focused on one of the most pressing challenges facing organisations today—moving AI beyond pilot projects into enterprise-wide implementation. Through expert-led discussions and real-world case studies, delegates will gain practical insights into deploying AI responsibly, scaling adoption and delivering measurable outcomes across key sectors of the economy. A key highlight will be a fireside conversation featuring Ho Kwon Ping , Founder and Executive Chairman of Banyan Group, on "Human-Centric AI: Redefining Trust, Experience and Leadership in the Intelligent Economy." Drawing on his experience building and leading a global hospitality business, Ho will explore how organisations can embrace AI while preserving human connection, trust and purpose, and how leadership must evolve as intelligent technologies become increasingly embedded in business and society. The other highlights in the programme include Embodied Intelligence: Bridging AI and Physical Action , which explores the next frontier of autonomous AI systems; Optimising Clinical Workflows with AI: Hospitals of the Future , examining how AI is transforming healthcare delivery; Autonomous Operations: AI in Ports, Airports & Freight Hubs , showcasing AI's role in strengthening critical infrastructure; and From Experimentation to Enterprise-Wide AI Deployment , where industry leaders will share practical lessons on overcoming implementation barriers and successfully scaling AI initiatives. "AI is entering a new phase where success depends on how effectively organisations can deploy and scale it in the real world. Through our partnerships with TechInnovation and AI Gravity, AIMX Singapore 2026 brings together the expertise, technologies and collaborations needed to accelerate AI adoption, create new business opportunities and strengthen Singapore's position as a leading hub for AI innovation." Jason Ng, Managing Director, MP Group . Co-organised with TechInnovation, AIMX Singapore 2026 extends beyond knowledge-sharing to drive tangible collaboration and commercialisation of diverse technologies that extends beyond AI. Through TechInnovation's tech-matching programme, participants can explore curated business meetings with enterprises, technology providers, researchers and investors to identify partnership and innovation opportunities. Delegates will also get the chance to speak with Innovation Advisors where they can receive guidance on business and technology adoption at IPI's booth at the event. "Most organisations today are not short of awareness about AI and innovation. What they need is a clear path from interest to implementation. Through TechInnovation we present a platform for businesses to cut through the noise, identify use cases that are grounded in real operational needs, and map out the next practical steps that will bring them close to create impactful outcomes.", Michael Goh, Chief Executive Officer, IPI Singapore . Advancing Global Collaborations AIMX Singapore 2026 further strengthens its international AI ecosystem in close partnership with AI Gravity , the international cross-collaboration platform of the World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) Shanghai . AI Gravity has supported the curation of the conference programme and exhibition, bringing together global AI leaders, technology enterprises and ecosystem partners to showcase emerging technologies, facilitate international business collaborations and create new opportunities for knowledge exchange across the region. Complementing the conference, AIMX Singapore 2026 will feature an international exhibition with more than 100 exhibitors from Singapore, Southeast Asia and beyond. With "token factories" from Run Jian, embodied AI & humanoid robots from AGIBOT , Weston Robot, R2 Robotics, Robocore, and Five Ages , to enterprise solutions from Zenative AI, Superb AI, Huawei and more , visitors can expect to experience market-ready solutions that are transforming industries and are already being deployed across healthcare, logistics, retail and manufacturing . Dedicated country and regional pavilions will spotlight AI innovation from across Asia, including the Hong Kong Pavilion led by HKSTP (Hong Kong Science & Technology Parks Corporation), the Japan Pavilion led by JCTI (Japanese Corporates Technology Innovation) Launchpad, and the Singapore Pavilion led by SAIA (Singapore AI Association) . Together with startups, research institutions and technology providers, these showcases will enable participants to discover emerging technologies, connect with innovators and explore practical AI solutions with real-world applications across industries. Accelerating AI Discovery & Deployment Alongside the conference and exhibition sections at AIMX Singapore 2026, attendees can look forward to discovering more deployable technologies and collaborations at the event. The AI Experience Zone : The AI Experience Zone will offer immersive and interactive experiences that showcase how artificial intelligence is transforming the way people work, create and engage with AI. Featuring demonstrations powered by generative AI, embodied AI and intelligent automation, the zone provides visitors with a hands-on opportunity to experience the practical applications of AI beyond the conference stage. The Ecosystem Lounge : Designed as a dynamic convergence point for the AI ecosystem, the Ecosystem Lounge brings together key sectors through a blend of hand-on workshops, deep dive sessions and networking opportunities to enable cross-sector and cross-border exchange, practical learning and meaningful collaborations. The Startup Zone : Experience emerging AI technologies from AI and tech startups leading the charge in the real-world deployment of AI across industries. The Business Matching Lounge : Through the AI-enabled capabilities of the AIMX Singapore event web app, attendees can pre-schedule and arrange for meetings with other attendees at the lounge, furthering conversations on AI adoption and deployment at the event. Registration for AIMX Singapore 2026 is now open. Complimentary passes are available for eligible industry professionals. For more information about AIMX Singapore 2026, please visit https://aimx.global/aimx-singapore-2026/ . About AIMX Singapore AIMX Singapore, the flagship event of the AIMX Network , is a premier global platform that brings together the full spectrum of the artificial intelligence ecosystem—from deep-tech innovators and startups to industry leaders, investors, researchers, and policymakers. It showcases cutting-edge AI advancements from across the world and provides a dynamic space to explore emerging applications, strategic partnerships, and cross-sector collaborations. At its core, AIMX Singapore invites participants to engage with a central, future-oriented question: How is AI shaping our present and defining our future? Through visionary keynotes, panel discussions, technical masterclasses, and interactive demonstrations, the event fosters meaningful dialogue and insight into both the transformative potential and the societal responsibilities of AI. Driven by a solution-oriented and collaborative approach, AIMX Singapore focuses on the practical implementation of AI technologies and the development of sustainable digital capabilities. It is designed to empower organisations and individuals—regardless of where they are in their AI journey—to adopt impactful solutions, enhance their AI literacy, and accelerate innovation. Through curated content tracks, hands-on learning, and targeted networking opportunities, AIMX Singapore supports real-world adoption while promoting ethical, inclusive, and responsible AI practices. By bridging global perspectives and uniting diverse stakeholders, AIMX Singapore plays a vital role in shaping an AI-enabled future that is equitable, effective, and aligned with the needs of communities. About TechInnovation TechInnovation is IPI Singapore's engagement platform aimed at empowering enterprises to discover the right technologies, connect with the right partners, and turn opportunities into real business outcomes. Its annual flagship event anchors a broader year-round effort to sustained, meaningful engagement between technology providers, businesses, and ecosystem partners. TechInnovation serves the full breadth of Singapore's enterprise ecosystem - from sustainability and healthcare to manufacturing, digital transformation, and beyond - connecting businesses with practical, deployable solutions that address real challenges. A key focus is supporting SMEs in identifying, adopting, and scaling the right technologies for sustainable growth. TechInnovation is organised by IPI Singapore, a subsidiary of Enterprise Singapore that enables SMEs to grow sustainably by providing guidance on technology and business solutions that prepare them for the future. TechInnovation ® is a registered trademark of IPI Singapore. About AI Gravity AI Gravity is a core programme within AIMX Singapore, designed as a strategic global initiative launched by the DLG Exhibition & Events Group. Its mission is to harness the transformative power of AI to connect markets, ecosystems, and industries — fostering cross-border collaboration opportunities that drive innovation and sustainable growth. As part of the AIMX Singapore, AI Gravity serves as a collaborative platform to bridge regional ecosystems, empower cross-border development, and cultivate international partnerships that accelerate the global AI landscape. Focusing on three strategic regions — Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, and Europe — AI Gravity leverages region-specific, high-level, and customized event platforms to achieve precise alignment between China's leading AI technologies and emerging international markets. Through engagement with governments, enterprises, investors, and academia, AI Gravity fosters a cross-border AI ecosystem that enables knowledge sharing, technology adoption, and business collaboration — empowering regional AI ecosystems to achieve long-term growth and breakthrough innovation. AI Gravity will empower partners across five key dimensions: Facilitating global investment and technology exchange: Promoting more active cross-border investment and technology collaboration between China and global AI ecosystems. Accelerating startup growth: Creating targeted connection channels for startups in China and ASEAN to engage with key investors, major enterprises, and regulatory authorities. Building bridges for public-private collaboration: Aligning resources and enabling joint efforts to drive efficient and coordinated AI industry development. Strengthening thought leadership: Uniting diverse perspectives to advance responsible AI development and enhance global influence. Expanding global networks: Establishing international partnerships in research, innovation, and commercialization to broaden global reach. Together with AIMX Singapore, our vision is to cultivate an open, inclusive, and future-oriented AI ecosystem where innovation transcends borders — empowering global collaboration and shared prosperity.
